home.intro: I lead an independent lab building knowledge assistants and practical AI systems. My current project is a knowledge assistant, built around retrieval, tool use, and durable conversation state.

founders.name: Michael Lvov
founders.bio: Principal architect: 20+ years in distributed systems & data platforms. AI/LLM agents, RAG. Building Nora SuperIntelligence Lab.
founders.background: My background includes real-time streaming at Capital One and petabyte-scale healthcare ingestion at Aetion. At Nora SuperIntelligence Lab, I apply that experience to stateful agents and retrieval systems.

contact.heading: Have a role or project in mind?
contact.body: If you have a technical leadership role or AI or data-platform project in mind, I’d be glad to hear about it.
